findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Industrial Piping & Integrated Engineering Solut" → 3 lines (6 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "PT. Airindo Teknologi Perkasa • Sejak 2013" above "Industrial Piping & Integrated Engineeri"; "Solusi Engineering Terintegrasi" above "Layanan Spesialis untuk Kebutuhan Indust"; "Mitra & Klien Industri" above "Dipercaya Perusahaan Terkemuka Nasional"; "Portofolio Rekayasa Lapangan" above "Pengalaman Teruji di Proyek Nasional"; "Tanya Jawab Teknis" above "Pertanyaan yang Sering Diajukan"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 138 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Switzer and Switzer, but the page renders Plus Jakarta Sans.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The margins differ: 132px on the left, 149px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Only 6 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 4 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Mechanical & Piping", "Electrical & Substation", "Process Automation & SCADA", "Power Plant Equipments"
